To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
BLE based system can replace CAN bus for communicating engine data between sensors and ECU, as well as ECU and OBU, in terms of reliability and energy efficiency.
BLE based system is a very promising candidate for intra vehicular wireless sensor networks.

BLE can be used for intra vehicle communication with acceptable energy consumption, throughput, latency, coverage and RSSI values, which makes it a very suitable candidate for future wireless communication systems.
In summary, our research is concerned with
energy efficiency, throughput and latency of BLE based communication in intra vehicle WSNs.
the use of BLE in vehicular environment for low power and energy efficient wireless communications.
development of low-cost and energy efficient BLE based Intra Vehicle Wireless Communication framework for Vehicular Ad-Hoc Networks.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
BLE is very promising for intra vehicular communication in terms of energy, cost and coverage area.
BLE based Intra Vehicle Wireless Network is a very promising alternative to CAN bus based communication system for future vehicles.
BLE can be employed as a viable alternative for intra vehicle communication for low data rate applications such as engine monitoring and control.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the proposed BLE based system can be employed in future vehicles as a low cost, low power, high throughput, and high reliable wireless communication solution for intra vehicular wireless sensor networks.
BLE can be employed in intra vehicle wireless sensor networks as an efficient and low cost solution for data communication.
BLE based system is a promising alternative for CAN bus in terms of energy consumption, reliability, coverage, and cost.
The main takeaway from our work is that
BLE can be used for low cost and reliable intra vehicular wireless communication in a vehicle.
BLE can be readily deployed as a cost-effective and energy efficient communication framework for intra vehicle wireless sensor networks.
BLE is a viable option for communication between ECUs and OBUs within the vehicle and between vehicles.
